remarks: Nicely updated 2 bedroom, 2nd floor unit in Stamford's charming Glenbrook neighborhood! This bright and inviting ranch-style home features fresh paint, brand-new engineered wood flooring, and a comfortable, open layout. Plenty of storage throughout, including generous closet space and an extra storage cabinet in the basement. The HOA covers all but electric, gas for cooking, and internet! 2 reserved parking spaces are conveniently located right off the rear entrance. Pet-friendly and investor-friendly, this well-maintained community offers easy access to I-95, Cove Island Park, Chelsea Piers, shops, and restaurants. A perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and value in one of Stamford's most desirable neighborhoods!
